summary: Bandwidth Inc. filed an 8-K on June 18, 2026, disclosing the entry into an indenture and the issuance of $316.25 million aggregate principal amount of 0% Convertible Senior Notes due 2032. The notes were sold to Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC, as representative of the initial purchasers, in a private placement under Rule 144A. The notes mature on July 1, 2032, bear no regular interest, and may accrue special interest at up to 0.50% upon certain events. The offering is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
